game.title: Battlefield 3
game.blurb: Military first-person shooter from Electronic Arts DICE, published by Electronic Arts, released 2011-10-25. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough (CC BY-SA 4.0) for the campaign and co-op, plus chapters drawn from Steam achievement themes for multiplayer and the expansions.

chapters.title: Campaign: Semper Fidelis to Comrades
chapters.summary: Campaign missions 1 to 6 on the contents page: Semper Fidelis, Operation Swordbreaker, Uprising, Going Hunting, Operation Guillotine and Comrades.

chapters.title: Campaign: Thunder Run to The Great Destroyer
chapters.summary: Campaign missions 7 to 12: Thunder Run, Fear No Evil, Night Shift, Rock and a Hard Place, Kaffarov and The Great Destroyer. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Co-op Missions
chapters.summary: The six co-op missions on the contents page: Operation Exodus, Fire from the Sky, Exfiltration, Hit and Run, Drop 'Em Like Liquid and The Eleventh Hour.

chapters.title: Multiplayer: Ribbons, MVP and Rank
chapters.summary: Ribbons for weapon, support and vehicle efficiency, MVP places, the first Dog Tag and Colonel rank.

chapters.title: Back to Karkand
chapters.summary: The first expansion's achievements: its ten weapons, the BTR-90, DPV and F-35, the skid loader and the Oman Hotel pool.

chapters.title: Close Quarters
chapters.summary: Gun Master, Conquest Domination, the ten CQ weapons and a hidden achievement (matched by API name and release order).

chapters.title: Armored Kill
chapters.summary: Tank Superiority, tank destroyers and mobile artillery, the Quad bike and the Gunship (matched by API name and release order).

chapters.title: Aftermath
chapters.summary: The xbow and its parts, Scavenger mode and the secret reptile (matched by API name and release order).

chapters.title: End Game
chapters.summary: Capture the Flag, motorcycles, AA jeeps and paradropped vehicles (matched by API name and release order).

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki has "Battlefield 3" at completion stage 2. Its contents list Gameplay, Controls, Achievements and trophies, a Walkthrough with 12 campaign missions (Semper Fidelis to The Great Destroyer), a Co-Op section with 6 missions and a Multiplayer section with 29 map pages. All 12 campaign mission pages are written (about 1,100 to 5,300 characters each), as are Walkthrough, Controls, Achievements and trophies and Table of Contents (16 written subpages in all); Gameplay, Co-Op, Multiplayer, the 6 co-op missions and every map page are linked but not written. 12 of the 18 campaign and co-op pages are written, so the campaign chapters follow its order; titles are our own and no text was copied. RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4397). The Steam store list has one match, app 1238820 ("Battlefield 3™"); its schema has only 34 achievements, all for multiplayer and the expansions, so the campaign and co-op chapters have no achievements. One is hidden ("Grinding the Crack", XP2 API name). RAWG lists five additions: Back to Karkand (2011-12-06), Close Quarters (2012-06-04), Armored Kill (2012-09-18), Aftermath (2012-12-11) and End Game (2013-03-05). The achievement API names have prefixes XPACH, XP2ACH, XP3ACH, XP4ACH and XP5ACH; only Back to Karkand is named in a description ("Back to Karkand weapons", on an XPACH achievement), and "CQ weapons" sits on an XP2 one. Matching XP2 to XP5 with the other four in RAWG release order is our own guess. "Like a Boss" (skid loader) and "Jaws" (Oman Hotel pool) carry XPACH names and sit with Back to Karkand on that basis. battlefield.fandom.com answers the API under "Battlefield 3" with at least 500 linked articles (the API limit), mostly weapons, vehicles and maps; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
